items.title: Naval Academy Engineer Named NAVFAC Washington 2027 Military Engineer of the Year
items.description:
Lt. Cmdr. Abigail Chek, who leads Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC) Washington’s Resident Officer in Charge of Construction Annapolis, has been named the command’s 2027 Military Engineer of the Year.

Selected from a competitive field of nominees, Chek now advances to the NAVFAC-wide competition. Capt. Daniel Schmitt, NAVFAC Washington commanding officer, cited her “relentless operational drive, engineering mastery, and unwavering commitment to mission readiness.”
